meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 启用后，能从 claude-mem 的观察记录中构建知识库：按项目、概念、日期等过滤形成语料，加载后可用日常语言提问，并支持列出、重建、重新加载语料库。
howto.when: 当你想从观察历史创建专注的知识库、询问过去的工作模式，或针对特定主题整理专长时触发。

say.text: 把关于 hooks 的所有观察记录建一个知识库。
基于上个月的决策记录建知识库，然后回答我几个问题。
say.note: 构建后自动加载，可连续提问。

say.text: 查一下我们项目里关于 worker 服务的 bug 修复记录。
say.note: 触发对已有语料的查询。

howto.what_en: Builds and queries knowledge bases from claude-mem observations: filter a corpus, load it into a session, ask natural-language questions. Also lists, rebuilds, and re-primes corpora.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users want to create focused knowledge bases from observation history, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

say_en.text: Create a knowledge base from all observations about hooks.
Build a knowledge base from last month's decisions, then answer a few questions.
Look up bug fix records about the worker service in our project.
